title: Citus: full cluster status (etcd DCS + coordinator HA + 2 worker-group HA)
description: Runs `nexus status citus` across all 9 nodes. One table rolls up the 3 etcd DCS members and the 3 Patroni groups (coordinator + worker1 + worker2), each 1 primary + 1 streaming replica (Shard column = the Patroni scope). Leaders DRIFT and are read from patronictl.

observe.what: 9-row table: 3 etcd alive (dcs), each of 3 groups 1 primary + 1 replica alive; leader = the coordinator group primary; overall green
JSON ClusterStatus: 9 members, overallHealth=green, shardId=scope per PG member, etcd shardId=null, leader=coord primary

whatProves: CitusAdapter.GetStatusAsync classifies nodes by name (etcd vs the 3 PG groups), reads each group's leader/replica from per-scope patronictl, and incorporates the etcd quorum + registered Citus worker count into the overall health.
